cta.body: Join a community call to learn more about specific opportunities, the application process, and how the economics work.

hero.lede: Join our thriving village economy. These opportunities align business success with community prosperity through shared revenue.

revenue.body: All businesses at {village} share a percentage of revenue with the community. This creates alignment between business success and community prosperity. The exact percentage is negotiated based on the business type and community investment.
